description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/upwind1_D_inflow_bc driven by problems/advection_1d_inflow_upwind.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — no per-resolution fixture files. The manufactured steady solution cos(pi x) is held by the exact forcing c dGdx with inflow gL = u*(0) = 1 (derivation and the inflow-compatibility argument in the problem file); the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are the pure 1st-order upwind truncation drift, expected to fall as O(dx). The inflow wall gradient u*_x(0)=0 keeps the boundary-cell residual O(dx) so the observed order is a clean 1 (a nonzero wall gradient would degrade it toward 1/2); order_tolerance is the standard 0.2, no loosening required (de-risk median observed order 0.98).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
